'''Baker group''' was a [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] of four [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]]. The [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were parked at a staging area when two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Missile Boat]]s arrived with orders to eliminate all TIE Defenders in the area. Though the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] attempted to get to their starfighters, Baker group was destroyed by the Imperials. The operation was later used as a training exercise for Missile Boat pilots.
